name: tranquil-automations
description: Write and run sandboxed TypeScript automations against any web app

showFolderCounts.title: Show Folder Counts in the Tree View
showFolderCounts.description: Show a direct-child count badge on collapsed folders in the tree view.

showRowActions.title: Show Rename/Delete Buttons on Tree View Rows
showRowActions.description: Show rename and delete buttons on hover over a tree view file or folder, so they don't require the right-click context menu.

showVerticalTabs.title: Show Vertical Tab List (Right Dock)
showVerticalTabs.description: Show a panel in the right dock listing the main view's open tabs; click one to activate it in the main view.

denoPath.title: Deno Path
denoPath.description: Absolute path to the `deno` binary used to run automations. Leave empty to find it on PATH.

approvedScriptPermissions.title: Approved Script Permissions
approvedScriptPermissions.description: Extra permission grants approved per script path (managed by the consent prompt; edit to revoke).

autoInjectScripts.title: Auto-run Scripts on URLs
autoInjectScripts.description: Scripts to run when a browser tab finishes loading a matching URL: entries of `{ pattern, path }`, where `pattern` is a regular expression for the URL. Each script still needs its permissions approved.

registeredAutomations.title: Registered Automations
registeredAutomations.description: Scripts registered as automation commands (Automation: …) by SDK: Register Current File, each with its command name and file path.

scriptState.title: Automation State
scriptState.description: What each automation saved with config.set, kept separately per script (managed by the scripts).
